customers_say: Customers find this water purifier to be among the best in the market, appreciating its premium appearance and excellent installation process. They consider it a budget-friendly option that makes a noticeable difference in water quality, and they find it easy to use with a hassle-free process. While some customers say the water tastes excellent, others report a bad taste.

reviews.author: Parusuram
reviews.title: Best purchase
reviews.body: Water purifier is too good. Taste of the water is also good.

reviews.author: Vikas
reviews.title: Premium Design and Good First Impression
reviews.body: The Native M1 Pro Water Purifier was installed just a day ago, and my initial experience has been good. The design looks premium, and the purifier seems convenient for daily use. It’s too early to comment on long-term performance and service, but so far, I’m satisfied with the overall experience.

reviews.author: Ashok kumar Alti
reviews.title: Value buy and very professional brand installation service
reviews.body: Very good product and super fast delivery by Amazon. Urban company as a brand is very professional with installation. Over all good product and experience

reviews.author: Rechardo
reviews.title: Great Purifier
reviews.body: Excellent purifier! Pure, sweet water, stylish design & quick service. Very happy with Uran Company - highly recommended.

reviews.author: Anchal Chaturvedi
reviews.title: Must change filters once in every 2 year and you are good to go.
reviews.body: It's a nice product. I am using it since 1 year and it's working perfectly fine, everything is under warranty so no worries and you just need to change filter once in 2 years making it cost effective too. Water quality is decent. Overall good product.
